execution_gate: Do not execute until the parent provides an explicit baseline-ready.json for the applied ten code cards.
oracle_policy: Expectations are frozen here before execution. A mismatch is fail, a missing prerequisite is blocked, and neither may be relabeled pass from observed output.

evidence_layers.copied_real_baseline: Public nodes run on separate copies of the applied real-code/RFC trial. Added/changed/deleted files are controlled test events, not actual upstream events or newly approved knowledge.
evidence_layers.synthetic_governance_fixture: Public planning/materialization interfaces over small explicit synthetic cards. These results do not establish real WiFi semantic correctness, human consent, production signatures, or content admission.

invariants: Never write to the baseline workspace, production implementation, original E:/Hi1105/wifi checkout, main designs, old history, or gold.
Every case owns a fresh short-path copy; failed copies and all request/response bytes are retained.
Do not re-sign, re-seal, or rebase existing proof/context/source identities to make a copied case pass.
No human event or publication signature is generated. Document and mixed confirmations without an event remain awaiting.
Formal cards, navigation and source lock stay unchanged except for each case's declared perturbation.
Copied immutable code identity may still name the original trial checkout for read-only checks. The runner never perturbs that path and does not claim a new isolated current-code identity.

cases.name: new_raw_discovered
cases.mutation: Copy exact RFC bytes to a new allowed raw path.
cases.expected: Complete scoped scan reports exactly that path as new; no formal card changes.

cases.name: changed_raw_keeps_partial
cases.mutation: Persist a partial defer record through public apply, then append a marked test observation to the raw copy.
cases.expected: Rescan reports changed and progress partial with correct old/new SHA-256.

cases.name: missing_raw_complete_scope
cases.mutation: Persist a blocked defer record, then delete only the owned raw copy.
cases.expected: Complete same-scope scan reports missing and preserves blocked progress; no card deletion.

cases.name: narrow_scan_preserves_outside_history
cases.mutation: Persist two raw observations, remove the second owned copy, scan only the first path.
cases.expected: Narrow scan does not report the second path missing; later complete scope does report it missing.

cases.name: partial_is_not_unchanged_skip
cases.mutation: Apply an explicit partial defer record and leave the observed bytes unchanged.
cases.expected: Next scan is unfinished with partial progress and an actionable unit; no substantive skip or adoption.

cases.name: unreviewed_substantive_skip_rejected
cases.mutation: Request substantive skip for a new raw unit without independent risk sample.
cases.expected: record returns nonzero with SKIP_SAMPLE_REQUIRED and creates no formal processing record.

cases.name: post_lint_edit_rejects_old_proof
cases.mutation: Plan and lint an update to a copied real card, edit its displayed final file, then attempt inspection and apply using the unchanged old baseline proof.
cases.expected: Initial new-view lint passes; candidate-inspect rejects FINAL_BYTES_CHANGED; unchanged old proof from another operation cannot authorize the new operation/view (structural scope/binding rejection, not a new semantic review); copied official cards stay unchanged. Public recover inspect checks a new record-only fact transaction created within this case and preserves that journal.
cases.assembly_note: Copied old code journals cannot be inspected as current under a different K root without new legitimate proof; that unrelated path is not exercised or counted.

cases.name: bad_frontmatter_rejected
cases.mutation: Replace one copied formal card with malformed YAML frontmatter.
cases.expected: Formal lint fails with a format finding for that card and never repairs bytes.

cases.name: broken_navigation_rejected
cases.mutation: Add a dangling link to the copied root knowledge index.
cases.expected: Formal lint fails in relation/navigation checking and never repairs the index.

cases.name: out_of_range_locator_rejected
cases.mutation: Set one copied card source locator beyond the captured original.
cases.expected: Formal lint fails in source checking for that card and leaves all other cards unchanged.

cases.name: source_hash_mismatch_rejected
cases.mutation: Supply one changed captured-source byte string as an explicit lint source_objects input.
cases.expected: Source integrity checking rejects the mismatching bytes; source finding paths are a nonempty subset of cards actually using that snapshot.

cases.name: corrupt_index_rebuild_preserves_cards
cases.mutation: Flip one byte in the copied active generation database, verify it, then build and fully verify a new generation.
cases.expected: Corrupt generation verification rejects; rebuilt generation verifies complete; all formal card/navigation/source-lock bytes remain identical.

cases.name: source_change_claim_lineage
cases.mutation: Two synthetic cards use independent raw snapshots; change only source A, then scan and prepare A.
cases.expected: Prepared candidates contain only card A, with adopted source claim_ids exactly A's Claim; card B and its source are unchanged. This is impact discovery, not automatic semantic invalidation.

cases.name: merge_complete_destinations
cases.mutation: Merge two old cards into one canonical card with explicit destinations for both old Claims.
cases.expected: Plan/materialize/inspect pass; both old cards are deprecated in the proposed complete view; formal fixture bytes remain unchanged.

cases.name: merge_missing_destination_rejected
cases.mutation: Omit one old Claim from merge mapping.
cases.expected: Planning rejects CLAIM_DESTINATION_REQUIRED before formal writes.

cases.name: split_complete_destinations
cases.mutation: Split one old card into two new cards and explicitly map its Claim to both.
cases.expected: Plan/materialize/inspect pass; old card is deprecated and both destinations exist in the proposed view; formal fixture bytes unchanged.

cases.name: split_unknown_destination_rejected
cases.mutation: Map an old Claim to a nonexistent new Claim.
cases.expected: Planning rejects the unknown Claim destination before formal writes.

cases.name: deprecate_live_requires_rejected
cases.mutation: Deprecate an old card that a stable dependent still requires, without a corresponding dependent edit.
cases.expected: Planning rejects the live incoming dependency; formal old and dependent cards remain unchanged.

cases.name: document_without_human_awaits
cases.mutation: Prepare an exact pure-document view and submit confirmation-record with no host_event_ref.
cases.expected: confirmation-record returns exit 3 / phase awaiting and no approved manual-review record or formal content write.

cases.name: mixed_without_human_awaits
cases.mutation: Prepare a mixed view containing a copied real code-card update and a new document card, then omit the human event.
cases.expected: View review_mode is mixed; confirmation-record returns exit 3 / phase awaiting; no approved manual-review record or formal content write.

revision.reason: Allow parallel public query append-only operation evidence without treating additions as baseline mutation; retain strict path/hash protection for every pre-existing file and reject new governed/source/index files. Add shard case IDs and unique suffix to report names.

assembly_preconditions: Install a fresh case catalog using the public installer and this case config; require unchanged Skill package fingerprints.
Copied real cases retain identical config bytes and the existing protected read-only workspace/main policy; old contexts and proofs are never rewritten.
Run unperturbed formal lint before mutations; raw-processing cases also require complete inspect-context with no affected Claims.
Index-rebuild case verifies the old proof explicitly with purpose historical before corrupting the index.
Any prerequisite or assembly mismatch is blocked before mutation and cannot count as a product refusal or pass.
Never call current proof validation on a copied old code context; it correctly binds its original knowledge_root.

concurrent_baseline_integrity.freeze: At process start, persist every existing readable workspace file path and SHA-256 in a unique immutable integrity-baseline manifest. Gold and interpreter cache exclusions remain unchanged.
concurrent_baseline_integrity.existing_files: Every frozen path must remain present with exactly the frozen hash, including original cards/raw/main/config/proofs/journals/active index and pre-existing operation files. No existing operation file is exempt.
allowed_additions: New files under K/.build/operations/ex26-public-* or K/logs/operations/ex26-public-* only.

New direct apply-code-proof-request-<24hex>.json or apply-code-proof-response-<24hex>.json files under an already-existing K/.build/operations/<original-op>/, because public query invokes the original apply proof checker.
concurrent_baseline_integrity.rejected_additions: Any other new workspace file, including knowledge cards, raw sources, main files, config, source lock, or index generation/pointer files.
concurrent_baseline_integrity.reporting: Record allowed added paths separately; missing/changed frozen paths or unexpected additions stop the run as changed_during_run. New operation logs do not count as content admission or new proof authority.
concurrent_baseline_integrity.shards: Reports and integrity manifests contain the selected case IDs, timestamp, and random run suffix; case directories remain exclusive and no scheduler is introduced.
